integrity: The conclusion is supported by an analytic variation-measure reduction and uniform Fourier-tail estimates. Finite checker assertions only corroborate the proof. Historical equivalence remains possible.
scientific_limitations: Asymptotic sharp constants and all-degree local midpoint curvature are established. Finite-degree global maximizing locations, their uniqueness, and extensions to other weights remain open.
title: A parity-sensitive second-order law for Chebyshev-second-kind projection of bounded-variation data
